script_text:
Capricorn, the cosmos demands your full attention this week, or you may miss your greatest professional opening.

Early Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in your 10th House squares your Sun, creating friction in career communications.

Yet Saturn, your ruling planet, sits in your 6th House trining your chart, offering steady support despite the noise.

As an Earth sign, you feel this physically.

Mid-week, Venus enters your 12th House in Virgo, shifting focus sharply from public work to hidden emotional needs.

By Thursday, Mars in your 9th House trines your sign, fueling bold career moves.

The Full Moon in Taurus on Thursday stresses your 4th House, urging work and home balance.

Friday is your power day because Venus blesses your romantic sector.

Wednesday is your worst day because Mercury opposes your ambition.

Actionable advice: negotiate important agreements before noon to avoid Saturn's rigid energy.

Follow for daily updates.
